question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

I thought till I wore my head __________ but I couldn't see any way out of the trouble.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sore"** means a feeling of pain or discomfort. (दर्द भरा)

 
 
• **Example: **After the long hike, my legs were **sore.**
 
 
 
• **"Sore" **is used in the context to describe a state of physical or mental fatigue or discomfort, making it the most suitable word to complete the sentence. (दर्द भरा)
 
 
• **Example: **He was thinking so hard that his head felt sore, but he couldn't come up with a solution.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **sore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Soar **(उड़ना): To fly or rise high in the air.

 
 
• **Example:** The eagle soared above the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Boar **(जंगली सुअर): A wild pig.
 
 
• **Example: **The hunter spotted a boar in the forest.
 
 
 
• **Bore** (उबाऊ): To make someone feel weary and uninterested.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so long that it began to bore the students.
